neighbours.label: the letter sequence 'ake' as a word ending or token (rake, sake, wake, snakes, maitake)
fire: In autumn we use a rake to clear the leaves from the lawn.
Please do it for the sake of the children.
The ship left a long white wake behind it in the bay.
Many lizards and snakes live among the rocks near the river.
The soup was made with shiitake and maitake mushrooms.
Counterfeiters rake in billions of dollars every year.
Every morning I wake up before the alarm goes off.
The garden shop sells rakes, hoes and shovels at a discount.
quiet: In autumn we use a broom to clear the leaves from the porch.
Please do it for the benefit of the children.
The ship left a long white trail behind it in the bay.
Many lizards and turtles live among the rocks near the river.
The soup was made with button and oyster mushrooms.
Counterfeiters earn billions of dollars every year.
Every morning I get up before the alarm goes off.
The garden shop sells hoses, gloves and shovels at a discount.

notes: Card: 'akes' x10, 'ake' x8, ' rake' x5, ' sake' x4, ' wake' x2 in the top 32. Layer 0 spelling unit. Near misses use words of similar length and topic that do not end in -ake.
